bio: Just outside Florence, yet it feels like you're already in the countryside, surrounded by greenery, and, in good weather, dining under the outdoor trees. Bibe is a traditional Italian trattoria with over 150 years of history, now in its sixth generation. The Tuscan cuisine features specialties such as cinta senese cured meats, finocchiona, pici pasta, beef peposo, and both fried and grilled chicken....
